1 1.
This case has arisen out of accident which occurred on RAKESH RAKESH KUMAR 02.01.2019 at MCD Barat Ghar Metro Station Gate No.2, Palam, KUMAR SINGH SINGH

Date:
2025.12.02 New Delhi.
The cause of accident was rash/ negligent driving of 17:54:40 +0530 vehicle no.DL-9SBQ-8451 which was being driven by Shiva.
The accident resulted into injuries to one SI Surender Kumar who was performing his duty.
The police registered an FIR no.07/2019 and investigated the matter.
Police thereafter filed chargesheet against the driver namely Shiva who was minor and therefore, the case was presented before JJB.
The police also filed a DAR before this tribunal.
2. The Ld. Predecessor conducted the proceedings.
The driver and owner did not file any reply.
The insurance company filed its reply.

On the basis of available material, Ld. Predecessor framed following issues:
1. Whether Surender Kumar sustained injuries in a motor vehicle accident dated 02.01.2019 due to rash and negligent driving of vehicle i.e. Scooty bearing no. DL 9S-BQ-8451, being driven & Owned by R-1 CCL Shiva R2 Santosh and insured by R-3/Oriental Insurance Company Ltd.?
Whether the petitoiner is entitled to claim compensation, if so, what amount and from whom?
...OPP 3. Relief.
Digitally 3.
During the evidence, Sh. Surender Kumar and ASI Anjeev signed by RAKESH RAKESH KUMAR Kumar were examined on the side of claimant.
Driver and owner KUMAR SINGH

Date:
SINGH 2025.12.02  17:54:46 did not appear to participate in the evidence.
Insurance company +0530 examined one Sh. Abhinav Kumar.
Both the sides have been heard.
This judgment will decide the case.
4. Occurrence of accident is mentioned in the FIR.
Involvement of the offending vehicle is also mentioned so.
Even a charge-sheet was filed against the driver Shiva.
In such circumstances, it cannot be accepted that the vehicle was not involved.
The insurance company has tried to impeach the credit of Surender Kumar but it has failed.
The cross-examination of Surender Kumar does not show any justification as to why he should be doubted on the point of accident, involvement of vehicle and rashness/ negligence.
Insurance company has not summoned the driver as a witness neither they have appointed any investigator.
In such circumstances, it is accepted that accident happened due to rash/ negligent driving of offending vehicle.

sentences.text: 5. We have then to see as to what amount of compensation should be awarded.
6. The injured has produced medical papers but accepts during cross-examination that medical bills were paid by CGHS.
Therefore, there is no necessity to allow compensation on this head.
Digitally signed by 7.

The injured in his cross-examination has also accepted that RAKESH RAKESH KUMAR KUMAR SINGH salary for leave period was dully credited but medical leaves SINGH Date:
2025.12.02 17:54:54 were deducted.

PW-2 who is Pairvee Officer of Delhi Police has +0530 appeared and has stated that injured was having monthly salary Rs.74,572/-
and had 168 Medical Leaves.
The leave record suggests that 164 Medical Leaves were taken by the injured.
8. It is at this stage, we have to consider special situation of a government servant.
Such persons are governed by Notified Leave Rules and are entitled for specific kind of leaves.
One of such leaves is called Commuted Leave and is given on the basis of illness of government servant.
This leave is generally reserved by the government servant for medical emergencies and whenever, he avails such leave, he is not granted regular salary but is granted leave salary.
Had this road accident not happened, the injured would not have been required to avail this commuted leave by exhausting his leave reserve.
He could have then utlized the commuted leave for his future illness but the motor accident has snatched his right over the 168 leaves.
Therefore, it cannot be said that injured was granted salary and did not suffer any loss of income.
I am of the view that the injured must be compensated for 84 days of loss which he could not enjoy in future.
His salary is apparently Rs.74,572/- with income tax of Rs.15,000/-.
Therefore, the loss of income for 30 days will be Rs.59,572/-.
In such circumstance, the loss of income for 84 days will be Rs.1,66,800/-.
This amount is allowed on account of loss of income.
There is not disability and therefore, there cannot be any RAKESH KUMAR loss of future earning.
SINGH 9.

Considering the fact that grievous injury has occasioned requiring repeated hospital visits, it is directed that the injured shall be allowed compensation on account of conveyance for Rs.5,000/-,
special diet for Rs.10,000/-, nursing attendant for Rs.5,000/-, pain & suffering for Rs.20,000/-,
inconvenience in life for Rs.10,000/-.
10. The total amount in this manner will be Rs.2,16,800/-.
The amount will carry a simple interest of 7.5 % per annum from 14.02.2020 to till realization.

sentences.text: Respondent Shiva (driver) being principal tortfeasor driving offending vehicle in rash/negligent manner is liable to pay compensation along with interest to injured.
The owner Santosh will be liable vicariously.
However, since offending vehicle was insured with the insurance company namely Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd. against third party risk so, the said insurance company shall be liable.
12. However, the chargesheet shows that offending driver did not have valid driving licence as offence U/s 181 of MV Act was also invoked.
There is no reason to disbelieve the chargesheet.
Insurance company had issued notice under Order XII Rule 8 CPC to the driver and owner but they did not respond.
Neither the driver nor the owner has appeared in evidence to contest the absence of driving licence.
Even otherwise, the driver was minor.
In such circumstances, a liability to indemnify cannot be imputed on insurance company.

13. Therefore, it is directed that insurance company shall pay the compensation to the injured and thereafter, it may recover the same from the owner either by filing execution petition of award or by obtaining recovery certificate.
14. Whenever compensation amount is deposited by insurance company, the same be released to the injured.
15. Let a separate Award be prepared based on the aforesaid calculation and directions, so that all the concerned persons can comply with the same.
